Metadata.description: How much of each payment is not yours, what you owe and when. Figures from the GestorIA engine.

Shell.disclaimer: GestorIA is a personal tool, not tax advice. Check anything important with a gestor or the AEAT.

Dashboard.title: Overview
Dashboard.lead: How much of each payment you receive is not yours, and what falls due next.

points.holdBack: The share of every incoming payment to put aside, explained in one sentence and in the full step-by-step calculation.
points.nextPayment: The next Modelo 130 payment and the days you can pay it.
points.cuota: The monthly TGSS cuota for this quarter, and when the tarifa plana ends.
points.renta: What the Renta will ask for on top of the Modelo 130 advances, and the month it is due.
points.warnings: Every warning from the calculation next to the figure it concerns, and the tax-year configuration that produced the answer.

Dashboard.pending: The estimate comes from the GestorIA API, which is not built yet.

Payments.title: Payments
Payments.lead: Everything you pay to Hacienda and the Seguridad Social, in date order.

points.obligations: Every obligation: Modelo 130, 303 and 349, the monthly TGSS cuota and the Renta true-up.
points.amounts: The amount when it is known, and a clear “not known yet” when it is not.
points.windows: The window for each payment after the weekend and regional holiday rules. Local holidays are not applied.
points.history: Past obligations with what was due, and an export of the dates to your calendar app.

Payments.pending: This needs the payment calendar and the quarterly and annual calculations from the API, which are not built yet.

Transactions.title: Transactions
Transactions.lead: The money that actually moved: what came in and what went out.

points.table: Every movement in a table that scrolls smoothly, even with thousands of rows.
points.filters: Filters by quarter and by kind of movement.
points.review: The movements that still need a decision: unclear ones and those missing an invoice.

Transactions.pending: This needs the transaction list and the review queue from the API, which are not built yet.

Periods.title: Periods
Periods.lead: Quarters and tax years, each with its results.

points.quarters: Each quarter's Modelo 130 and 303 results with their line numbers.
points.years: Each tax year's annual result (Renta) and how it was reached.
points.trace: The step-by-step calculation, grouped by section.

Periods.pending: This needs the quarterly and annual calculations from the API, which are not built yet.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.lead: Language, theme, your profile and your data, in one place.

points.profile: Your taxpayer profile for each year: region, family situation, salary and autónomo registration.
points.data: Exporting or deleting all your data, with a confirmation that names what will be deleted.

Settings.pending: The profile and your data live in the API, which is not built yet.

Auth.title: Access
Auth.lead: Unlocking the app with the key of your local installation.

points.key: Entering the local API key, so that nothing on this machine talks to the API without it.
points.status: A clear message when the API is not running, so you know to start it.

Auth.pending: This needs the API and its key check, which are not built yet.

Backup.title: Backup
Backup.lead: A copy of your data that lives outside this machine.

points.export: Exporting all your data in one file, labelled as personal financial data.
points.restore: Restoring your data from that file, so a lost laptop does not lose your tax history.

Backup.pending: Export needs the API, which is not built yet. Restore also needs an API design that does not exist yet.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.lead: There is nothing at this address.
